name: 91316 · Encino, CA
findings: ZIP 91316 (Encino) has 181 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91316 (Encino) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
